svg.aria-label: An isometric engineer's desk. A monitor on a post and arm shows an editor with one terracotta line lit and code typing itself in; an articulated desk lamp throws a warm pool of light across a low-profile keyboard and mouse. A stack of books and a mug with steam sit beside a small potted plant; a three-drawer cabinet and a cable trough carry the clutter. A person in a hooded top wears over-ear headphones and works at the keyboard, seen from behind on a five-star office chair.
